scope: credential-free model catalog adapter drift observability
change: Verified catalog comparisons expose sorted affected adapter identifiers and map each adapter to deterministic model identifiers for additions, removals and changed models before and after adapter migration.

semantics.added: current-catalog model identifiers introduced on the adapter
semantics.removed: previous-catalog model identifiers removed from the adapter
semantics.changedBefore: changed model identifiers classified by their previous adapter
semantics.changedAfter: changed model identifiers classified by their current adapter
semantics.empty: unchanged and source-revision-only reports expose empty affectedAdapterIds and driftModelIdsByAdapter values
